name: Mr Surender Kumar, IFS (Retd.)
title: Senior Advisor
experience: 33+ years in Indian Forest Service and legal practice
bio: Mr Surender Kumar took voluntary retirement from Indian Forest Service after a distinguished career spanning more than 33 years. During his tenure, he held diverse assignments including Secretary, Environment Department, Member Secretary, Tripura Bio-diversity, CEO Indo-German Development Project, and Director, Ministry of Development of North Eastern Region. He contributed to the drafting of the amendment to the Wildlife Protection Act, 1972, and represented India in the Interpol group on wildlife crime. He has considerable experience in corporate governance and served as MD, TRPC, and represented the central government on the board of North Eastern Developmental Finance Corporation (NEDFi) and NERAMAC.
publications: Ban on single use polythene and Noise Pollution Rules

name: Mr Hem Chandra Pant
title: Senior Counsel
education: FCS (Fellow of the Institute of Company Secretaries of India)
experience: 30+ years in legal field, 20+ years with BSNL as Chief General Manager (Legal)
bio: Mr Hem Chandra Pant has extensive hands-on experience dealing with a comprehensive range of legal issues. While working with BSNL as Chief General Manager (Legal) for over two decades, he advised top management on Corporate Laws, Capital market regulatory and Securities laws, contracts, Telecom regulatory & business laws, arbitration, employment & service laws, anti-corruption laws and compliance mechanism. He has handled high stake litigation involving direct and indirect taxes, contracts, employment and service matters. He has been a member of management teams for joint ventures, M&As, demergers and disinvestment.

name: Ms Namrata Khandelwal, C.A.
title: Financial & Business Advisor
experience: 20+ years in Business, Financial and Project Management
bio: Ms Namrata Khandelwal is a Chartered Accountant with more than 20 years of experience in Business, Financial and Project Management, Accounting, liaison and coordination with Government officials at all levels. She has handled ICAI Accounting Research Foundation (ICAI ARF), the research arm of the Institute of Chartered Accountants of India for more than 7 years. She has executed several projects for Government Ministries like Indian Railways, Ministry of Housing & Urban Affairs, Ministry of Rural Development, Ministry of Panchayati Raj, and regulators like Office of Comptroller & Auditor General of India. An expert at multi-tasking, handling multiple projects simultaneously with teams ranging from 5 to 100+ professionals.

name: Mr Devender Kumar Sharma
title: Senior Advocate
bio: Mr Devender Kumar Sharma is a practicing advocate with over 32 years of experience in managing and strategizing complex legal issues. Over his long and illustrious career, he has handled high-profile cases involving Land Acquisition, Contracts, and Corporate Disputes. He is an expert in property due diligence and handles high-value property deals on a regular basis. He also advises clients on asset management, company and LLP registration, and estate planning.

name: Mr Udayan Khandelwal
title: Managing Partner
education: Member, Delhi High Court Bar Association
experience: 15+ years in litigation and dispute resolution
bio: Mr Udayan Khandelwal is a practising Advocate in various courts and quasi-judicial tribunals across the country including Arbitration. He has immense experience in successfully representing clients including high net-worth individuals and companies before various judicial and quasi-judicial fora. Mr Khandelwal is a result-oriented lawyer with extensive experience in Arbitral Claims, Defences, Petitions Under the Arbitration and Conciliation Act, Civil and Commercial Litigation, Economic Offences, Anti-Corruption Laws, Competition Law, Insolvency and Bankruptcy, and Family & Personal Laws. He also advises clients on alternative dispute resolution including mediation and conciliation.

name: Mr Rahul Dubey, LLM (UCL, London)
title: Intellectual Property Counsel
education: LL.M. in Intellectual Property Rights, University College London
Certificates in IPR and Competition Laws from WIPO, Geneva
experience: 10+ years in IP litigation and corporate law
bio: Mr Rahul Dubey is an alumnus of University College London holding a degree of Masters in Law (LL.M.) in Intellectual Property Rights. He was Delhi ambassador for World Bank Group in its programmes of Ease of Doing Business in India and Enforcement of Contracts in India. Mr Dubey has represented clients in high profile IPR litigation culminating into textbook cases. He has appeared in landmark cases including Monsanto Technology LLC vs Nuziveedu Seeds Ltd., Sungro Seeds Ltd. vs S.K. Tripathi, Delhi Public School Society vs DPS World Foundation, and Prabhat Agri Biotech Ltd. vs Registrar of Plant Varieties. He was invited by University of Helsinki, Finland to speak on IPR and Artificial Intelligence.
publications: Arbitrability of IPR disputes (Satyam International Publication, ISBN: 978-93-91345-11-2)
IPR and Artificial Intelligence (University of Helsinki)

name: Mr Shubhankar Sharma
title: Partner
experience: 10+ years in litigation and regulatory compliance
bio: Mr Shubhankar Sharma, a practicing advocate, has immense experience in the field of Litigation & Dispute Resolution. He has worked extensively with Food & Beverage industry, Hospitality & Tourism businesses and Education Companies, advising them on company incorporation, statutory registrations including FSSAI, Weights and Measures, Real Estate, Compliances & other documentation. He is also an expert in the newly drafted Drone Rules, 2021 and Certification Scheme for Unmanned Aircraft Systems.

name: Mr Abhishek Tewathia
title: Associate
experience: 8+ years in criminal and matrimonial litigation
bio: Mr Abhishek Tewathia, a practicing advocate, has immense experience in the field of Criminal and Matrimonial Litigation & Dispute Resolution. He has extensive experience and a good success rate in securing Bail and Anticipatory Bail for clients. His expertise includes handling complex criminal matters, matrimonial disputes, and providing strategic legal counsel in sensitive cases.

name: Mr. Rakshit Jain
title: Tax & Financial Advisor
education: Professional Qualification in Finance and Taxation
experience: 12+ years in Audit, Banking, Finance and Taxation
bio: Mr. Rakshit Jain is a well qualified professional with over 12 years of experience in the field of Audit, Banking, Finance and Direct & Indirect Taxation. Given his effective liaison skills, he has an impressive track record of successfully coordinating with Government organizations in various matters. He specializes in business advisory with a special focus on Startups including documentation, Mergers and De-mergers, and Insolvency & Bankruptcy Advisory.
